boundary: Representation-independent only under the fixed 145-state carrier, add-only chiral Weyl matter, ordinary SU(3) Dynkin normalization, and the stated one-loop coefficient. It is not a no-go for all gauge embeddings or ultraviolet completions.
escape_routes: remove or reassign original colored degrees of freedom
replace the assumed four-dimensional nonsupersymmetric one-loop matter content/dynamics
proof: The nonzero SU3^3 anomaly forces every add-only repair to add colored chiral matter.
Any colored addition raises the total Dynkin load from 16 by at least 1/2, so strict b0>0 is impossible.
At the marginal b0=0 limit the only allowed colored load is exactly one weak-singlet 3 or 3bar, whose cubic anomaly magnitude is 1 and cannot cancel magnitude 28.
Therefore every add-only anomaly-free repair of the fixed carrier has b0_SU3<0, independent of how high the added SU3 representation search is extended.
representation_theorem: Every nontrivial finite-dimensional SU(3) irrep has Dynkin index T(R)>=1/2, with equality only for 3 or 3bar.
